method.combined_weighting: One equally weighted valid hypothetical observation; instruments with more observations receive more weight. R is additive bookkeeping, not a capital-weighted portfolio.
method.win_rate: W/(W+L+B), with unresolved and ambiguous counts and all-trade bounds shown separately.
method.binomial_test: One-sided exact binomial H0 p<=1/3. Nominal +2/-1 gross-payoff threshold; not a test of cost-adjusted profitability, and IID assumption may fail.
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR alpha=.05 across 422 exploratory subgroup binomial tests in one family. Overlapping correlated groups and temporal dependence mean q-values are descriptive, not confirmed discoveries.
method.exploration: Only in_sample + validation; final out_of_sample excluded from subgroup discovery and bin fitting.
method.sessions: Exclusive labels of all active sessions: Asian 09:00–18:00 Asia/Tokyo; London 08:00–17:00 Europe/London; New York 08:00–17:00 America/New_York. IANA timezone DST respected. Other if none. Windows apply every calendar day; not exchange opening hours or holiday calendars.
method.time_features: At pattern confirmation, in UTC unless session explicitly local.
method.drawdown: Peak cumulative realized R minus current cumulative R, including initial zero. Ordered by exit_time; equal timestamp ties stable. No mark-to-market or portfolio capital constraints.
method.streaks: Chronological exit-time sequence; ambiguous/unresolved entered trades interrupt streaks; invalid and no-entry observations excluded.
method.excursions: As supplied by simulator; exit-bar extrema are bounds if intrabar sequence unknown.
method.costs: Sensitivity assumes total round-trip bps times entry/risk, subtracts from resolved gross R. Funding excluded.
method.assumptions: No strategy or threshold chosen by observed performance. Historical significance cannot establish future profitability.
